identity: Rows of the same MAT, not timestamp-based event matching
matching: Hungarian maximum summed IoU; edges below threshold are zeroed BEFORE optimization; only eligible assigned edges count
true_positives: Sum of intersections of eligible one-to-one matched pairs
false_positives: All predicted nonzero spikes minus true positives (including unmatched clusters)
false_negatives: All reference nonzero spikes minus true positives
expert_unit_macro: All reference units, unmatched units score zero; matched-only averages must be labeled separately
pure_reference_noise_cluster: Predicted nonzero cluster with zero overlap with any reference nonzero unit
empty_denominator: Return 0, not NaN, and retain counts
scope: Curation against expert labels; not a claim of biological ground truth or a full SpikeInterface timing benchmark
